title: Upper Triangular Matrix and Lower Triangular Matrix
diagram_summary: Comparison of upper triangular matrix (U) with zeros below the diagonal and lower triangular matrix (L) with zeros above the diagonal, both 4×4 examples.
diagram_elements: Upper Triangular Matrix U: a₁₁ a₁₂ a₁₃ a₁₄; 0 a₂₂ a₂₃ a₂₄; 0 0 a₃₃ a₃₄; 0 0 0 a₄₄
Lower Triangular Matrix L: a₁₁ 0 0 0; a₂₁ a₂₂ 0 0; a₃₁ a₃₂ a₃₃ 0; a₄₁ a₄₂ a₄₃ a₄₄
